item.title: 'Dawson's Creek' star James Van Der Beek dies at 48 following cancer battle
item.description: James Van Der Beek, the actor who captured hearts as the lead in teen melodrama 'Dawson's Creek,' died Wednesday at age 48. His wife Kimberly announced his death via Instagram, stating he met "his final days with courage, faith, and grace." The actor revealed his Stage 3 colorectal cancer diagnosis in early November 2024 and chronicled his battle on social media, regularly paying tribute to his family for their support throughout his illness.
